mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id, f.product_id, f.create_time, p.title AS product_title, p.image_url AS product_image_url, p.price AS product_price, p.status AS product_status, u.nickname AS seller_nickname FROM favorite f LEFT JOIN product p ON f.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
